#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Explicit ms09 whole-case/interval registry. No legacy aggregate15/16 acceptance is imported.
Progress can use pre-child pins; FINAL formula mode recomputes every consumed CNF. SAT candidates veto the entire
component. Missing/invalid inputs or commits fail closed; only exact B3 has a separately bound parent math proof.
Calibration reservations stay pending unless an exact read-only parent disposition authorizes their pinned inputs.
"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import time
from pathlib import Path

import encode_skel_b as ENC
import m2_ms09_evidence as E
import structural_b3_acceptance as B3

LANE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
REVIEW = LANE.parents[3]/'institute'/'runs'/'six-lane-2026-10-16'/'review'
P0 = [4,3,3,3,3,3]
SCHEMA = 'PA19-MS09-K1-v1'
SKELETON_SHA = '7c46ebbad3389476407e99807593287a8b3bb6c6a80f34574f0e9c00134293d0'
MAP_SHA = 'd06bb6fce38a2fbf96cf7d84d18331ec8233b54ccdccfc4b4ec759f281aa5282'
ENCODER_SHA = 'd0002e60d11ef5cba568309fde5b15e29280ca127bc0e6bb1f4d22929a5628e5'
PHASE_PATH = 'cycle2/ms09-batch-denominators-v2-20261018T015110.json'
PHASE_SHA = 'd0d0d7fa9dae6ab263b05af800c0967916adf840c7583613d98c15d41d810d33'
SOURCE_FILES = ('src/encode_skel_b.py','src/gen_skel_b.py','src/extend_b.py','src/extend_b_x.py',
                'src/stream_check15.py','src/calibration_chunk_budget.py','src/m2_ms09_evidence.py',
                'src/m2_ms09_contract.py','src/freeze_m2_ms09_k1.py','src/run_m2_ms09_k1.py','src/final_m2_ms09_inventory.py')


def key(bi,lo,hi):
    return 'b%05d:%05d-%05d' % (bi,lo,hi)


def read(p):
    return json.loads(Path(p).read_bytes())


def publish_bytes(path,raw,staging):
    """Atomic NO-REPLACE publication; both own staging/final hardlinks remain (no deletion/overwrite)."""
    path,staging = Path(path),Path(staging)
    assert path.parent.resolve().is_relative_to(LANE.resolve()) and staging.resolve().is_relative_to(LANE.resolve()), 'publication escapes owned lane'
    staging.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    tmp = staging/(path.name+'.%d-%d' % (os.getpid(),time.time_ns()))
    with tmp.open('xb') as f:
        f.write(raw)
    os.link(tmp,path)


def publish_json(path,value,staging):
    raw = (json.dumps(value,indent=1)+'\n').encode()
    publish_bytes(path,raw,staging)
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def verify_sources(c):
    assert c['schema'] == SCHEMA and [x['b_index'] for x in c['cases']] == list(range(71))
    assert all(type(x['b_index']) is int for x in c['cases'])
    assert c['skeleton_path'] == 'cycle2/skel-b/skeletons-b-ms09.json' and c['skeleton_sha256'] == SKELETON_SHA
    assert c['map_path'] == 'cycle2/skel-b/compare-map-ms09.json' and c['map_sha256'] == MAP_SHA
    assert c['source_sha256']['src/encode_skel_b.py'] == ENCODER_SHA
    assert set(c['source_sha256']) == set(SOURCE_FILES), 'required frozen source set differs'
    for rel,h in c['source_sha256'].items():
        assert not Path(rel).is_absolute() and (LANE/rel).resolve().is_relative_to(LANE.resolve())
        assert E.digest(LANE/rel) == h, ('frozen source changed',rel)
    assert E.digest(LANE/c['skeleton_path']) == SKELETON_SHA and E.digest(LANE/c['map_path']) == MAP_SHA
    d,mp = read(LANE/c['skeleton_path']),read(LANE/c['map_path'])
    assert d['c0'] == 5 and d['L'] == 0 and len(d['skeletons']) == 71 and mp['bijection'] is True
    assert sorted(mp['a_to_b']) == list(range(71))
    assert c['phase_path'] == PHASE_PATH and c['phase_sha256'] == PHASE_SHA
    assert E.digest(LANE/PHASE_PATH) == PHASE_SHA, 'original complete denominator authority changed'
    phase = read(LANE/c['phase_path'])
    phase_rows = phase['pending_batch_jobs']+phase['already_complete_cases']+phase['structural_pending_parent']
    for ref in c.get('frozen_original_records',[]):
        assert E.digest(LANE/ref['path']) == ref['sha256'], ('frozen original receipt changed',ref['path'])
    order = []
    for ca in c['cases']:
        bi = ca['b_index']
        assert ca['mapped_A2_tag'] == 'ms09_s%05d' % mp['a_to_b'].index(bi)
        assert ca['skeleton_sha256'] == hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(d['skeletons'][bi],sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
        ls = ca.get('list')
        if ls:
            assert ls['path'] == 'cycle2/m2part_drat/ms09_b%05d/ext.json' % bi
            eraw = (LANE/ls['path']).read_bytes()
            assert hashlib.sha256(eraw).hexdigest() == ls['sha256'], ('frozen list changed',bi)
            ed = json.loads(eraw)
            n = ls['n']
            assert all(type(ed[k]) is int for k in ('num_placements','raw_class_assignments','automorphisms'))
            assert type(n) is int and type(ls['raw']) is int and type(ls['aut']) is int
            assert 0 <= n == ed['num_placements'] == len(ed['placements']) <= ls['raw'] == ed['raw_class_assignments']
            assert ls['aut'] == ed['automorphisms'] > 0
            ph = next(x for x in phase_rows if x['job'] == '9:%d' % bi)
            assert ls['sha256'] == ph['list_sha256'] and n == ph['complete_placement_denominator']
            expected = [[lo,min(n,lo+100)-1] for lo in range(0,n,100)]
            assert [it['indices'] for it in ca['intervals']] == expected and sum(hi-lo+1 for lo,hi in expected) == n
            for it in ca['intervals']:
                lo,hi = it['indices']
                assert all(type(v) is int for v in it['indices']) and it['id'] == key(bi,lo,hi)
                base = 'cycle2/m2part_drat/ms09_b%05d/batch_%05d_%05d' % (bi,lo,hi)
                assert it['original'] == base+'.json' and it['new_record'] == base+'_k1.json'
                assert it['pin'] == base+'_k1.cnf-pin.json' and it['commit'] == base+'_k1.receipt.json'
                assert it['claim'] == 'cycle2/claims/m2k1_ms09_b%05d_%05d_%05d.claim' % (bi,lo,hi)
                if it['id'] in c['reserved_ids']:
                    assert not (LANE/it['new_record']).exists(), 'reserved calibration interval was duplicated into production'
                if it.get('baseline'):
                    ex = it['baseline']['expected']
                    assert it['baseline']['path'] == it['original'] and ex['multiset'] == 9 and ex['b_index'] == bi and ex['indices'] == [lo,hi]
        else:
            assert bi == 1 and not ca['intervals'] and ca['direct'], 'only pinned direct B1 lacks a list'
        if ca.get('direct'):
            ex = ca['direct']['expected']
            assert ca['direct']['path'] == 'cycle2/m2skel_drat/ms09_b%05d.json' % bi
            assert ex['multiset'] == 9 and ex['b_index'] == bi and ex['indices'] is None and ex['encoder'] == 'encode_skel_b.build_v2'
    assert len(c['reserved_ids']) == len(set(c['reserved_ids'])) == 7
    required_reserved = {key(9,0,99),key(4,100,199),key(70,0,24),key(13,0,99),key(20,0,99),key(31,0,99),key(55,0,99)}
    assert set(c['reserved_ids']) == required_reserved
    assert {r['id'] for r in c['calibration_reservations']} == required_reserved
    bycase = {ca['b_index']:ca for ca in c['cases']}
    for ref in c['calibration_reservations']:
        bi,idx = ref['b_index'],ref['indices']
        assert type(bi) is int and isinstance(idx,list) and len(idx) == 2 and all(type(v) is int for v in idx)
        assert ref['id'] == key(bi,*idx) and ref['list_sha256'] == bycase[bi]['list']['sha256']
        assert ref['expected']['multiset'] == 9 and ref['expected']['b_index'] == bi and ref['expected']['indices'] == idx
        assert E.digest(LANE/ref['record']) == ref['record_sha256'] and E.digest(LANE/ref['pin']) == ref['pin_sha256']
        assert E.digest(LANE/ref['calibration_contract']) == ref['calibration_contract_sha256']
        for rel,h in ref['source_sha256'].items():
            assert E.digest(LANE/rel) == h, ('frozen calibration source changed',rel)
    for ca in sorted(c['cases'],key=lambda x:((x['list'] or {}).get('n',-1),x['b_index'])):
        if ca['direct'] or not ca['list'] or ca['list']['n'] == 0:
            continue
        order += [it['id'] for it in ca['intervals'] if not it['baseline'] and it['id'] not in required_reserved]
    assert c['pending_order'] == order, 'compute order is not the exact deterministic full unresolved partition'


def structural_acceptance(c,ca):
    if not (type(ca['b_index']) is int and ca['b_index'] == 3 and type(ca['list']['n']) is int and ca['list']['n'] == 0
            and c['skeleton_sha256'] == SKELETON_SHA
            and ca['list']['sha256'] == B3.EXPECTED['empty_list_receipt']['sha256']):
        return {'accepted':False,'scope':'no generic empty-cover acceptance'}
    return B3.verify()


def load(path,h):
    assert E.digest(path) == h, 'production contract SHA differs'
    c = read(path)
    verify_sources(c)
    assert (c['native_seconds'],c['check_seconds'],c['chunk_seconds'],c['allowance_seconds']) == (600,1200,10800,2400)
    assert c['batch_size'] == 100 and c['count_ceiling'] == 2
    return c


def formula(c,ca,indices):
    """EXACT original run_m2_15 constructor/arguments; no M1 encoder/clauses or new symmetry."""
    sp = LANE/c['skeleton_path']
    raw = sp.read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == c['skeleton_sha256']
    D = json.loads(raw)
    sk = D['skeletons'][ca['b_index']]
    assert hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(sk,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest() == ca['skeleton_sha256']
    special = [p for p in D['profiles'] if list(p) != P0]
    if indices is None:
        nv,cl = ENC.build_v2(D['c0'],[tuple(t) for t in sk['types']],sk['empty'],special)
    else:
        ls = ca['list']
        raw = (LANE/ls['path']).read_bytes()
        assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == ls['sha256']
        data = json.loads(raw)
        assert data['num_placements'] == len(data['placements']) == ls['n'] > 0
        assert data['raw_class_assignments'] == ls['raw'] and data['automorphisms'] == ls['aut']
        lo,hi = indices
        nv,cl = ENC.build_partbatch(D['c0'],[tuple(t) for t in sk['types']],sk['empty'],special,
                                   [data['placements'][i] for i in range(lo,hi+1)])
    return ENC.cnf_bytes(nv,cl)


def context(bi,indices,sha,nbytes,kissat=False):
    return E.expected(9,bi,indices,sha,nbytes,'encode_skel_b.build_v2' if indices is None else 'encode_skel_b.build_partbatch',600,kissat)


def parent_reuse(c,contract_sha,path=None,h=None):
    if path is None:
        return {}
    p = Path(path).resolve()
    assert p.is_relative_to(REVIEW.resolve()), 'reuse disposition must be in read-only parent review ownership'
    assert h and E.digest(p) == h
    d = read(p)
    assert d['schema'] == 'PA19-MS09-CALIBRATION-REUSE-v1' and d['production_contract_sha256'] == contract_sha
    byid = {x['id']:x for x in c['calibration_reservations']}
    accepted = {}
    for item in d['accepted']:
        ident = item['id']
        assert ident in byid and ident not in accepted
        assert isinstance(item.get('indices'),list) and len(item['indices']) == 2 and all(type(v) is int for v in item['indices'])
        ref = byid[ident]
        for name in ('record_sha256','cnf_sha256','list_sha256','indices'):
            assert item[name] == ref[name], ('parent overlay identity differs',ident,name)
        assert item['scope'] == 'EXACT_INPUT_ONLY'
        accepted[ident] = ref
    return accepted


def sat_scan():
    """Scan all actual ms09 scientific/calibration JSON, including unrecognized extra records; not controls."""
    paths = set((LANE/'cycle2'/'m2skel_drat').glob('ms09_b*.json'))
    for d in (LANE/'cycle2'/'m2part_drat').glob('ms09_b*'):
        if d.is_dir():
            paths.update(d.glob('*.json'))
    for pattern in ('m2-kissat-calibration-*','m2-kissat-strata-calibration-*'):
        for d in (LANE/'cycle2').glob(pattern):
            if d.is_dir():
                paths.update(d.glob('*.json'))
    paths.update((LANE/'cycle2'/'m2k1-chunks').glob('*/SAT-*.json'))
    paths.update((LANE/'cycle2'/'witness').glob('m2k1*.json'))
    aborted = LANE/'cycle2'/'aborted'
    paths.update(aborted.glob('*.json'))
    flag = LANE/'cycle2'/'m2k1-SAT.flag'
    if flag.exists():
        paths.add(flag)
    sats,invalid = [],[]
    for p in sorted(paths):
        try:
            r = read(p)
        except (OSError,ValueError,UnicodeError) as exc:
            invalid.append({'path':str(p.relative_to(LANE)),'error':repr(exc)})
            continue
        if not isinstance(r,dict):
            invalid.append({'path':str(p.relative_to(LANE)),'error':'scientific JSON is not an object'})
            continue
        if p.parent == aborted and not (r.get('multiset') == 9 or 'ms09_' in str(r.get('fifo_dir','')) or str(r.get('tag','')).startswith('ms09_')):
            continue
        if isinstance(r,dict) and r.get('status') == 'SAT':
            sats.append({'path':str(p.relative_to(LANE)),'sha256':E.digest(p)})
    return sats,invalid


def inspect_new(c,contract_sha,ca,it,verify_formula=False):
    p = LANE/it['new_record']
    if not p.exists():
        return {'state':'MISSING','errors':[],'sat':False}
    try:
        pin = read(LANE/it['pin'])
        commit = read(LANE/it['commit'])
        assert pin['schema'] == 'PA19-K1-CNF-PIN-v1' and commit['schema'] == 'PA19-K1-RECEIPT-v1'
        assert pin['production_contract_sha256'] == commit['production_contract_sha256'] == contract_sha
        assert type(pin['b_index']) is int and type(commit['b_index']) is int
        assert isinstance(pin['indices'],list) and isinstance(commit['indices'],list)
        assert len(pin['indices']) == len(commit['indices']) == 2
        assert all(type(v) is int for v in pin['indices']+commit['indices'])
        assert pin['b_index'] == commit['b_index'] == ca['b_index'] and pin['indices'] == commit['indices'] == it['indices']
        assert pin['list_sha256'] == ca['list']['sha256'] and pin['complete_denominator'] == ca['list']['n']
        assert pin['skeleton_sha256'] == c['skeleton_sha256'] and pin['encoder_sha256'] == c['source_sha256']['src/encode_skel_b.py']
        assert commit['pin_sha256'] == E.digest(LANE/it['pin']) and commit['record_sha256'] == E.digest(p)
        ctx = context(ca['b_index'],it['indices'],pin['cnf_sha256'],pin['cnf_bytes'],True)
        if verify_formula:
            raw = formula(c,ca,it['indices'])
            assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == pin['cnf_sha256'] and len(raw) == pin['cnf_bytes']
        r = E.inspect(p,ctx,commit['record_sha256'])
        obj = r.get('record') or {}
        assert isinstance(obj,dict), 'scientific proof record is not an object'
        assert obj.get('production_contract_sha256') == contract_sha and obj.get('pre_child_pin_sha256') == commit['pin_sha256']
        assert obj.get('list_sha256') == ca['list']['sha256'] and obj.get('count_for_scientific_coverage') is True
        assert obj.get('runner') == 'run_m2_ms09_k1.py' and obj.get('enumerator') == 'extend_b.py'
        assert obj.get('stream_check_revision') == 15 and type(obj.get('complete_denominator')) is int
        assert obj['complete_denominator'] == ca['list']['n']
        return r
    except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,AssertionError,TypeError) as exc:
        return {'state':'INVALID','errors':['new record/pin/commit binding failed: '+repr(exc)],'sat':False}


def inventory(c,contract_sha,accepted_cal=None,verify_formulas=False):
    verify_sources(c)
    accepted_cal = accepted_cal or {}
    sats,issues = sat_scan()
    rows,covered_indices,open_indices = [],0,0
    for ca in c['cases']:
        bi = ca['b_index']
        if ca.get('direct'):
            dr = ca['direct']
            chk = E.inspect(LANE/dr['path'],dr['expected'],dr['sha256'])
            if chk['state'] != 'QUALIFIED':
                issues.append({'case':bi,'direct':chk['errors']})
            elif verify_formulas:
                raw = formula(c,ca,None)
                assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == dr['expected']['cnf_sha256'], 'direct formula hash differs'
            rows.append({'b_index':bi,'state':'DIRECT_CHECKED' if chk['state'] == 'QUALIFIED' else 'OPEN','solver_checked':chk['state'] == 'QUALIFIED'})
            continue
        if ca['list']['n'] == 0:
            proof = structural_acceptance(c,ca)
            rows.append({'b_index':bi,'state':'STRUCTURAL_PARENT_MATH' if proof.get('accepted') else 'OPEN_EMPTY_NO_VACUOUS_ACCEPTANCE',
                         'solver_checked':False,'structural':proof})
            continue
        states = []
        for it in ca['intervals']:
            ident = it['id']
            if ident in c['reserved_ids']:
                ref = accepted_cal.get(ident)
                if ref is None:
                    state = 'RESERVED_PARENT_DISPOSITION'
                else:
                    chk = E.inspect(LANE/ref['record'],ref['expected'],ref['record_sha256'])
                    assert E.digest(LANE/ref['pin']) == ref['pin_sha256']
                    if verify_formulas:
                        raw = formula(c,ca,it['indices'])
                        assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == ref['cnf_sha256'] and len(raw) == ref['expected']['cnf_bytes']
                    state = 'COVERED' if chk['state'] == 'QUALIFIED' else 'INVALID'
                    if state == 'INVALID': issues.append({'interval':ident,'calibration':chk['errors']})
            elif it.get('baseline'):
                ref = it['baseline']
                chk = E.inspect(LANE/ref['path'],ref['expected'],ref['sha256'])
                if verify_formulas:
                    raw = formula(c,ca,it['indices'])
                    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == ref['expected']['cnf_sha256']
                state = 'COVERED' if chk['state'] == 'QUALIFIED' else 'INVALID'
                if state == 'INVALID': issues.append({'interval':ident,'baseline':chk['errors']})
            else:
                chk = inspect_new(c,contract_sha,ca,it,verify_formulas)
                state = 'COVERED' if chk['state'] == 'QUALIFIED' else chk['state']
                if state == 'INVALID': issues.append({'interval':ident,'new':chk['errors']})
            size = it['indices'][1]-it['indices'][0]+1
            if state == 'COVERED': covered_indices += size
            else: open_indices += size
            states.append({'id':ident,'indices':it['indices'],'state':state})
        done = bool(states) and all(s['state'] == 'COVERED' for s in states)
        rows.append({'b_index':bi,'state':'FULL_INTERVAL_UNION_CHECKED' if done else 'OPEN','solver_checked':done,
                     'denominator':ca['list']['n'],'intervals':states})
    resolved = sum(r['state'] in ('DIRECT_CHECKED','FULL_INTERVAL_UNION_CHECKED','STRUCTURAL_PARENT_MATH') for r in rows)
    for row in rows:
        row['closed_for_final'] = bool(verify_formulas and not sats and not issues and row['state'] in
                                      ('DIRECT_CHECKED','FULL_INTERVAL_UNION_CHECKED','STRUCTURAL_PARENT_MATH'))
    return {'scope':'ms09 component ONLY; not a global PA19/M1/other-multiset verdict','rows':rows,'cases':71,
            'progress_receipt_resolved_cases':resolved,'closed_cases_for_final':sum(r['closed_for_final'] for r in rows),
            'progress_solver_receipt_cases':sum(r['solver_checked'] for r in rows),'structural_parent_math_cases':sum(r['state'] == 'STRUCTURAL_PARENT_MATH' for r in rows),
            'covered_placement_indices':covered_indices,'open_placement_indices':open_indices,'sat_veto':sats,'integrity_issues':issues,
            'formula_verification_mode':verify_formulas,'final_ms09_acceptance_ready':bool(verify_formulas and resolved == 71 and not sats and not issues and all(x in accepted_cal for x in c['reserved_ids'])),
            'parent_calibration_reservations_pending':[x for x in c['reserved_ids'] if x not in accepted_cal]}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Freeze the COMPLETE unchanged ms09 independent-B route before production (metadata only, existing token).
Existing claimed qualifying receipts are numerically rebound to regenerated B CNFs, not trusted by legacy aggregate.
All seven calibration intervals are reserved for explicit parent disposition; no counting/rerun is authorized here.
"""
import hashlib
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

import lane_new_data_accounting as ACCOUNT
import m2_ms09_contract as C
import m2_ms09_evidence as E

L = C.LANE
PHASE = L/'cycle2'/'ms09-batch-denominators-v2-20261018T015110.json'

CAL1_SHA = '4565dcc9a2a99eba9efa565409d00ebbc37aa3bf8a6c3793895d4de7a39eef71'
CAL2 = 'cycle2/m2-kissat-strata-contract-20261018T030136.json'
CAL2_SHA = '9c3e76a2d9c001724d902b4d40923284b629919dd508f163a7fcc02728e57d74'
CAL_BATCHES = [(CAL1,CAL1_SHA,'m2-kissat-calibration-20261018T022704',9,0,99),
              (CAL1,CAL1_SHA,'m2-kissat-calibration-20261018T022704',4,100,199)] + [
    (CAL2,CAL2_SHA,'m2-kissat-strata-calibration-20261018T030136',bi,0,24 if bi == 70 else 99) for bi in (70,13,20,31,55)]


def main():
    phase = C.read(PHASE)

    mappath = 'cycle2/skel-b/compare-map-ms09.json'
    D,mp = C.read(L/skpath),C.read(L/mappath)
    assert len(D['skeletons']) == 71 and D['c0'] == 5 and D['L'] == 0
    assert mp['bijection'] is True and sorted(mp['a_to_b']) == list(range(71))
    source_names = C.SOURCE_FILES
    out = {'schema':C.SCHEMA,'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),
        'scope':'ALL original ms09 cases; unchanged independent B encoder; full exact original B100 interval unions',
        'source_sha256':{p:E.digest(L/p) for p in source_names},'skeleton_path':skpath,'skeleton_sha256':E.digest(L/skpath),
        'map_path':mappath,'map_sha256':E.digest(L/mappath),'phase_path':str(PHASE.relative_to(L)),'phase_sha256':E.digest(PHASE),
        'native_seconds':600,'check_seconds':1200,'batch_size':100,'count_ceiling':2,'chunk_seconds':10800,'allowance_seconds':2400,
        'kissat_binary_sha256':E.digest('/opt/homebrew/bin/kissat'),'drat_trim_binary_sha256':E.digest(L/'tools/drat-trim/drat-trim'),
        'cases':[],'calibration_reservations':[],'reserved_ids':[],'pending_order':[],'frozen_original_records':[],
        'no_retry':'one new _k1 attempt per unresolved interval; originals/UNKNOWNs/calibrations unchanged; stale/incomplete claims need parent disposition',
        'final_gate':'every exact interval, SAT veto, no empty vacuity, final formula regeneration and independent parent reader; ms09 component is not whole PA19 acceptance'}
    frozen = {}
    def freeze_file(rel):
        h = E.digest(L/rel)
        frozen[rel] = h
        return h
    for bi in range(71):
        sk = D['skeletons'][bi]
        ca = {'b_index':bi,'mapped_A2_tag':'ms09_s%05d' % mp['a_to_b'].index(bi),
              'skeleton_sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(sk,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),
              'list':None,'direct':None,'intervals':[]}
        dp = 'cycle2/m2skel_drat/ms09_b%05d.json' % bi
        if (L/dp).exists():
            r = C.read(L/dp)
            rh = freeze_file(dp)
            assert r.get('status') != 'SAT', ('SAT VETO',dp,rh)
            if r.get('status') == 'UNSAT' and r.get('checked') is True:
                raw = C.formula(out,ca,None)
                ex = C.context(bi,None,hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),len(raw))
                q = E.inspect(L/dp,ex,rh)
                assert q['state'] == 'QUALIFIED', (dp,q['errors'])
                ca['direct'] = {'path':dp,'sha256':rh,'expected':ex}
        ep = 'cycle2/m2part_drat/ms09_b%05d/ext.json' % bi
        if (L/ep).exists():
            ed = C.read(L/ep)
            n,raw_n,aut = ed['num_placements'],ed['raw_class_assignments'],ed['automorphisms']
            assert type(n) is int and type(raw_n) is int and type(aut) is int and 0 <= n == len(ed['placements']) <= raw_n and aut > 0
            ca['list'] = {'path':ep,'sha256':E.digest(L/ep),'bytes':(L/ep).stat().st_size,'n':n,'raw':raw_n,'aut':aut}
            expected_phase = next((x for x in phase['pending_batch_jobs']+phase['already_complete_cases']+phase['structural_pending_parent'] if x['job'] == '9:%d' % bi),None)
            assert expected_phase and ca['list']['sha256'] == expected_phase['list_sha256']
            assert n == expected_phase['complete_placement_denominator']
            for lo in range(0,n,100):
                hi = min(n,lo+100)-1
                base = 'cycle2/m2part_drat/ms09_b%05d/batch_%05d_%05d' % (bi,lo,hi)
                it = {'id':C.key(bi,lo,hi),'indices':[lo,hi],'original':base+'.json','new_record':base+'_k1.json',
                      'pin':base+'_k1.cnf-pin.json','commit':base+'_k1.receipt.json',
                      'claim':'cycle2/claims/m2k1_ms09_b%05d_%05d_%05d.claim' % (bi,lo,hi),'baseline':None}
                assert not (L/it['new_record']).exists() and not (L/it['claim']).exists(), 'new production namespace already exists'
                if (L/it['original']).exists():
                    r = C.read(L/it['original'])
                    rh = freeze_file(it['original'])
                    assert r.get('status') != 'SAT', ('SAT VETO',it['original'])
                    if r.get('status') == 'UNSAT' and r.get('checked') is True:
                        buf = C.formula(out,ca,[lo,hi])
                        ex = C.context(bi,[lo,hi],hashlib.sha256(buf).hexdigest(),len(buf))
                        q = E.inspect(L/it['original'],ex,rh)
                        assert q['state'] == 'QUALIFIED', (it['original'],q['errors'])
                        it['baseline'] = {'path':it['original'],'sha256':rh,'expected':ex}
                ca['intervals'].append(it)
        else:
            assert bi == 1 and ca['direct'], 'missing list not justified by exact complete direct case'
        if ca['list'] and ca['list']['n'] == 0:
            proof = C.B3.verify()
            assert bi == 3 and proof['accepted'], 'no generic empty-list acceptance'
            ca['parent_structural_note_sha256'] = proof['parent_note_sha256']
        out['cases'].append(ca)
    bycase = {x['b_index']:x for x in out['cases']}
    for cp,ch,folder,bi,lo,hi in CAL_BATCHES:
        assert E.digest(L/cp) == ch
        cc = C.read(L/cp)
        for rel,h in cc['source_and_input_sha256'].items():
            assert E.digest(L/rel) == h
        name = 'calibration_ms09_b%05d_%05d_%05d' % (bi,lo,hi)
        rp = 'cycle2/%s/%s.json' % (folder,name)
        pp = 'cycle2/%s/%s.cnf-pin.json' % (folder,name)
        ca = bycase[bi]
        buf = C.formula(out,ca,[lo,hi])
        ex = C.context(bi,[lo,hi],hashlib.sha256(buf).hexdigest(),len(buf),True)
        q = E.inspect(L/rp,ex)
        r,pin = q.get('record'),C.read(L/pp)
        assert q['state'] == 'QUALIFIED' and r['count_for_scientific_coverage'] is False and r['calibration_scope_bound'] is True and r['calibration_valid_unsat'] is True
        assert pin['contract_sha256'] == ch and pin['b_index'] == bi and pin['indices'] == [lo,hi]
        assert pin['cnf_sha256'] == ex['cnf_sha256'] and pin['cnf_bytes'] == ex['cnf_bytes']
        assert pin['list_sha256'] == ca['list']['sha256'] and pin['complete_placement_denominator'] == ca['list']['n']
        ref = {'id':C.key(bi,lo,hi),'record':rp,'record_sha256':q['sha256'],'pin':pp,'pin_sha256':E.digest(L/pp),
               'calibration_contract':cp,'calibration_contract_sha256':ch,'b_index':bi,'indices':[lo,hi],
               'cnf_sha256':ex['cnf_sha256'],'cnf_bytes':ex['cnf_bytes'],'list_sha256':ca['list']['sha256'],
               'complete_denominator':ca['list']['n'],'expected':ex,'source_sha256':cc['source_and_input_sha256'],
               'existing_original_also_covers':bool(next(it for it in ca['intervals'] if it['indices'] == [lo,hi]).get('baseline')),
               'policy':'RESERVE, never rerun or count until exact parent disposition; originals remain count=false'}
        out['calibration_reservations'].append(ref)
        out['reserved_ids'].append(ref['id'])
    assert len(out['reserved_ids']) == len(set(out['reserved_ids'])) == 7
    for ca in sorted(out['cases'],key=lambda x:((x['list'] or {}).get('n',-1),x['b_index'])):
        if ca['direct'] or not ca['list'] or ca['list']['n'] == 0:
            continue
        for it in ca['intervals']:
            if not it['baseline'] and it['id'] not in out['reserved_ids']:
                out['pending_order'].append(it['id'])
    out['frozen_original_records'] = [{'path':p,'sha256':h} for p,h in sorted(frozen.items())]
    out['resource_plan'] = {'current_new_data':ACCOUNT.account(L),'per_interval_retained_upper_bytes':65536,
        'all_new_compute_intervals':len(out['pending_order']),'all_new_compute_retained_upper_bytes':len(out['pending_order'])*65536,
        'concurrent_lane_metadata_margin_bytes':64*1024**2,'no_proof_or_cnf_copies':True}
    a = out['resource_plan']['current_new_data']
    assert a['known'] and a['new_data_usage_upper_bytes']+out['resource_plan']['all_new_compute_retained_upper_bytes']+64*1024**2 <= ACCOUNT.ENFORCED_CAP_BYTES
    sats,invalid = C.sat_scan()
    assert not sats and not invalid, ('SAT/invalid JSON veto',sats,invalid)
    dest = L/'cycle2'/('m2-ms09-k1-contract-'+time.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')+'.json')
    stage = L/'scratch'/'m2k1-publish'/('contract-'+str(time.time_ns()))
    h = C.publish_json(dest,out,stage)
    proposal = {'schema':'PA19-MS09-CALIBRATION-REUSE-v1','production_contract_sha256':h,
       'status':'PROPOSAL ONLY; parent must write/disposition an exact overlay in read-only review ownership',
       'accepted':[{'id':r['id'],'record_sha256':r['record_sha256'],'cnf_sha256':r['cnf_sha256'],
          'list_sha256':r['list_sha256'],'indices':r['indices'],'scope':'EXACT_INPUT_ONLY'} for r in out['calibration_reservations']]}
    proposal_path = L/'cycle2'/('m2-ms09-k1-parent-reuse-PROPOSAL-'+time.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')+'.json')
    C.publish_json(proposal_path,proposal,stage)
    print(dest)
    print('contract_sha256',h,'pending_new_compute',len(out['pending_order']),'reserved',len(out['reserved_ids']))
    print(proposal_path)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

src/run_m2_ms09_k1.py.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Full unchanged independent-B ms09 continuation; source-review PASS required before launch.
Deterministic frozen interval order. Exactly one new Kissat600/check1200 attempt per unresolved nonreserved B100
interval, original receipts/UNKNOWNs immutable, new exclusive _k1 names. Seven calibration inputs ALWAYS reserved
here: never rerun or counted; a separate parent-authorized final reader may consume their exact proofs.
One <=3h chunk incl waits via reviewed budget overlay; all native/proof/cap/ownership behavior stays guard15.
Atomic no-replace proof/pin/commit publication retains own staging hardlinks; no proof/CNF copies or deletion.
Usage: run_m2_ms09_k1.py CONTRACT SHA [--max-attempts N] (operational tranche only; full target unchanged).
"""
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import time
from pathlib import Path

import lane_new_data_accounting as ACCOUNT
import m2_ms09_contract as C
import m2_ms09_evidence as E
import stream_check15 as S
from calibration_chunk_budget import ChunkBudget

L = C.LANE


def claim(path,contract_sha,ident):
    p = L/path
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    try:
        fd = os.open(p,os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY,0o644)
    except FileExistsError:
        return False
    try:
        os.write(fd,('%d %s %s %s\n' % (os.getpid(),time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),contract_sha,ident)).encode())
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    return True


def release_unattempted(path,reason):
    src = L/path
    dst = L/'archive'/'k1-unattempted-claims'/('%s.%d' % (src.name,time.time_ns()))
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    assert not dst.exists()
    h = E.digest(src)
    os.rename(src,dst)
    with (L/'archive'/'MANIFEST.tsv').open('a') as f:
        f.write('%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' % (time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),path,str(dst.relative_to(L)),h,reason))


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('contract')
    ap.add_argument('sha256')
    ap.add_argument('--max-attempts',type=int)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    if args.max_attempts is not None:
        assert args.max_attempts > 0
    S.install_sigterm_handler()
    S.set_stop_files([str(L/'cycle2'/'STOP-m2r12'),str(L/'cycle2'/'m2k1-SAT.flag')])
    cutoff = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat('2026-10-18T18:31:43-07:00').timestamp()
    budget = ChunkBudget(S,cutoff)
    runid = '%s-%d-%d' % (time.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S'),os.getpid(),time.time_ns())
    stage = L/'scratch'/'m2k1-publish'/runid
    logs = L/'cycle2'/'m2k1-chunks'/runid
    logs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    try:
        with budget:
            with S.Token(stage='ms09-k1-initialize'):
                c = C.load(args.contract,args.sha256)
                assert E.digest(S.KISSAT) == c['kissat_binary_sha256'] and E.digest(S.DT) == c['drat_trim_binary_sha256']
                initial = C.inventory(c,args.sha256)
                assert not initial['sat_veto'] and not initial['integrity_issues'], 'SAT/integrity veto; no production admitted'
                accounting = ACCOUNT.account(L)
                pending_ids = set(c['pending_order'])
                remaining = sum(not (L/it['new_record']).exists() for ca in c['cases'] for it in ca['intervals']
                                if it['id'] in pending_ids)
                all_route_bound = remaining*65536 + 64*1024**2
                tranche = min(remaining,args.max_attempts) if args.max_attempts is not None else remaining
                this_chunk_bound = tranche*65536 + 64*1024**2
                assert accounting['known'] and accounting['new_data_usage_upper_bytes']+all_route_bound <= ACCOUNT.ENFORCED_CAP_BYTES
                free = S.disk_free_bytes()
                required = max(S.DISK_FLOOR,12267108864+this_chunk_bound)
                assert free >= required, 'this bounded tranche retained metadata does not fit fresh disk margin'
                C.publish_json(logs/'admission.json',{'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),
                    'contract_sha256':args.sha256,'fresh_free_bytes':free,'required_free_bytes':required,
                    'current_new_data':accounting,'all_remaining_route_metadata_upper_bytes':all_route_bound,
                    'this_chunk_metadata_upper_bytes':this_chunk_bound,'operational_max_attempts':args.max_attempts,
                    'no_proof_or_cnf_copies':True},stage)
    except (Exception,SystemExit) as exc:
        C.publish_json(logs/'initialization-deferred.json',{'status':'UNKNOWN/deferred',
            'reason':repr(exc),'this_runner_native_has_started':False,'contract_sha256':args.sha256,
            'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')},stage)
        print(logs,repr(exc),flush=True)
        return
    byid = {it['id']:(ca,it) for ca in c['cases'] for it in ca['intervals']}
    records,attempts,stop = [],0,None
    for ident in c['pending_order']:
        if args.max_attempts is not None and attempts >= args.max_attempts:
            stop = 'bounded operational tranche reached; target/remaining intervals unchanged'
            break
        stop = budget.reason()
        if stop:
            break
        ca,it = byid[ident]
        if ident in c['reserved_ids']:
            raise AssertionError('reserved calibration must never enter compute order')
        if (L/it['new_record']).exists():
            q = C.inspect_new(c,args.sha256,ca,it)
            if q['state'] in ('INVALID','SAT'):
                stop = 'existing new-record integrity/SAT veto: '+ident
                break
            continue  # QUALIFIED or a preserved first-attempt UNKNOWN: NO AUTO RETRY.
        if not claim(it['claim'],args.sha256,ident):
            continue  # another/stale owner, never guess ownership or reclaim automatically.
        hold = {}
        def build():
            assert E.digest(args.contract) == args.sha256
            for rel,h in c['source_sha256'].items():
                assert E.digest(L/rel) == h, ('source changed after token wait',rel)
            assert E.digest(S.KISSAT) == c['kissat_binary_sha256'] and E.digest(S.DT) == c['drat_trim_binary_sha256']
            assert not (L/it['new_record']).exists(), 'exclusive output unexpectedly appeared'
            raw = C.formula(c,ca,it['indices'])
            h = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
            hold.update(cnf_sha256=h,cnf_bytes=len(raw))
            pin = {'schema':'PA19-K1-CNF-PIN-v1','host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),
                'production_contract_sha256':args.sha256,'b_index':ca['b_index'],'indices':it['indices'],
                'cnf_sha256':h,'cnf_bytes':len(raw),'list_sha256':ca['list']['sha256'],
                'complete_denominator':ca['list']['n'],'skeleton_sha256':c['skeleton_sha256'],
                'encoder_sha256':c['source_sha256']['src/encode_skel_b.py'],'proof_retained':False,'cnf_retained':False}
            hold['pin_sha256'] = C.publish_json(L/it['pin'],pin,stage)
            return raw
        try:
            with budget:
                r = S.kissat_staged(build,str(L/'scratch'/'fifo'/('m2k1_'+ident.replace(':','_'))),600,1200)
        except (Exception,SystemExit) as exc:
            r = {'status':'UNKNOWN','checked':False,'reason':repr(exc)}
            stop = repr(exc)
        if not hold:
            C.publish_json(logs/('deferred-'+ident.replace(':','_')+'.json'),
                {'status':'UNKNOWN/deferred','id':ident,'reason':r.get('reason') or r.get('admission_denied'),
                 'no_completed_constructor':True,'no_native_possible_before_constructor_returns':True},stage)
            release_unattempted(it['claim'],'K1 admission/construction deferred before complete constructor; no native could start')
            stop = stop or r.get('admission_denied') or 'construction/admission deferred'
            break
        attempts += 1
        raw_status = r.get('status')
        r.update(multiset=9,b_index=ca['b_index'],indices=it['indices'],encoder='encode_skel_b.build_partbatch',enumerator='extend_b.py',
            runner='run_m2_ms09_k1.py',production_contract_sha256=args.sha256,list_sha256=ca['list']['sha256'],
            complete_denominator=ca['list']['n'],pre_child_pin_sha256=hold.get('pin_sha256'),
            count_for_scientific_coverage=True,proof_retained=False,solver_status_before_qualification=raw_status)
        if raw_status == 'SAT':
            witness = logs/('SAT-'+ident.replace(':','_')+'.json')
            wh = C.publish_json(witness,dict(r,scope='unverified PA19 SAT candidate; parent direct verifiers required'),stage)
            if not (L/'cycle2'/'m2k1-SAT.flag').exists():
                C.publish_json(L/'cycle2'/'m2k1-SAT.flag',{'status':'SAT','candidate':str(witness.relative_to(L)),
                    'candidate_sha256':wh,'contract_sha256':args.sha256,'id':ident},stage)
            print('SAT_CANDIDATE',str(witness),wh,flush=True)
        r['solver_out'] = ''
        ex = C.context(ca['b_index'],it['indices'],hold['cnf_sha256'],hold['cnf_bytes'],True)
        errors = E.proof_errors(r,ex)
        if not hold.get('pin_sha256'):
            errors.append('pre-child pin was not published')
        r['proof_qualification_errors'] = errors
        if errors:
            r['checked'] = False
            if raw_status != 'SAT':
                r['status'] = 'UNKNOWN'
        raw_record = (json.dumps(r,indent=1)+'\n').encode()
        rh = hashlib.sha256(raw_record).hexdigest()
        commit = {'schema':'PA19-K1-RECEIPT-v1','production_contract_sha256':args.sha256,'b_index':ca['b_index'],
                  'indices':it['indices'],'record_sha256':rh,'pin_sha256':hold.get('pin_sha256'),
                  'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')}
        C.publish_json(L/it['commit'],commit,stage)
        # Publish the primary LAST: a visible primary always has its immutable pin and receipt already present.
        C.publish_bytes(L/it['new_record'],raw_record,stage)
        item = {'id':ident,'record':it['new_record'],'record_sha256':rh,'pin_sha256':hold.get('pin_sha256'),
                'status':r['status'],'checked':r['checked'],'solve_seconds':r.get('solve_seconds'),
                'check_seconds':r.get('check_seconds'),'proof_bytes':r.get('drat_bytes'),'cnf_sha256':r.get('cnf_sha256')}
        records.append(item)
        print(json.dumps(item),flush=True)
        if raw_status == 'SAT' or S.ABORT[0] or r.get('admission_denied') or stop:
            stop = stop or r.get('admission_denied') or 'SAT/abort veto'
            break
    C.publish_json(logs/'summary.json',{'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),
        'production_contract_sha256':args.sha256,'attempts':attempts,'records':records,'stop_reason':stop,
        'reserved_calibration_inputs_untouched':c['reserved_ids'],'no_global_PA19_verdict':True},stage)
    print(logs,flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fail-closed ms09 component inventory. Run under an existing token; --verify-formulas is mandatory for FINAL.
No legacy aggregate15/16 helper is imported. A read-only parent review disposition is required to consume any
of the seven exact calibration inputs; absent it they remain reserved, never rerun/counted automatically.
This is the ms09 component, NOT a global M1/M2/PA19 verdict; the final global independent reader is separate.
"""
import argparse
import json
import time

import m2_ms09_contract as C


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('contract')
    ap.add_argument('sha256')
    ap.add_argument('--parent-reuse')
    ap.add_argument('--parent-reuse-sha256')
    ap.add_argument('--verify-formulas',action='store_true')
    args = ap.parse_args()
    c = C.load(args.contract,args.sha256)
    accepted = C.parent_reuse(c,args.sha256,args.parent_reuse,args.parent_reuse_sha256)
    out = C.inventory(c,args.sha256,accepted,args.verify_formulas)
    out.update(host_clock=time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),production_contract_sha256=args.sha256,
               parent_reuse_path=args.parent_reuse,parent_reuse_sha256=args.parent_reuse_sha256,
               schema='PA19-MS09-FINAL-INVENTORY-v1')
    dest = C.LANE/'cycle2'/('m2-ms09-inventory-%s-%d.json' % (time.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S'),time.time_ns()))
    h = C.publish_json(dest,out,C.LANE/'scratch'/'m2k1-publish'/('inventory-'+str(time.time_ns())))
    print(dest)
    print('sha256',h)
    print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in out.items() if k != 'rows'},indent=1))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

src/check_m2_ms09_k1.py.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Final new-route metadata/policy controls, run ONCE under an existing token after contract freeze.
No native solver/checker is started. Tests use real completed calibration metadata plus private tiny copies/symlinks;
original evidence is read-only. Contract/identity/unknown-revision/verdict/replay/SAT/empty/atomic guards are tested,
with single-protection source mutants. These are NOT DRAT-proof mutation tests or a security claim against forged
entire execution histories. No deletion/overwrite: changed fixture originals are moved to private archive/.
"""
import argparse
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import os
import time
import types
from pathlib import Path

import m2_ms09_contract as C
import m2_ms09_evidence as E

REAL_LANE = C.LANE


def dump_x(p,obj):
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with p.open('x') as f:
        json.dump(obj,f,indent=1)


def proof_controls(mod,r,ex):
    assert not mod.proof_errors(r,ex)
    cases = []
    def setp(label,keys,value):
        q = copy.deepcopy(r)
        node = q
        for k in keys[:-1]: node = node[k]
        node[keys[-1]] = value
        cases.append((label,q))
    for label,keys,val in [
        ('unknown revision',['stream_check_revision'],999),('boolean revision',['stream_check_revision'],True),
        ('wrong multiset',['multiset'],6),('wrong case',['b_index'],4),('wrong interval',['indices'],[0,98]),
        ('boolean index',['indices'],[False,99]),('wrong encoder',['encoder'],'encode_skel.py'),
        ('wrong CNF SHA',['cnf_sha256'],'0'*64),('wrong CNF size',['cnf_bytes'],r['cnf_bytes']+1),
        ('not UNSAT',['status'],'SAT'),('not solver20',['solver_rc'],0),('solver not self',['solver_stop'],'term'),
        ('unchecked',['checked'],False),('reader missing',['reader_ok'],None),('replay false',['replay_ok'],False),
        ('delivery count',['replay','bytes'],r['drat_bytes']+1),('delivery SHA',['replay','sha256'],'0'*64),
        ('replay error',['replay','error'],'broken pipe'),('checker exit',['drat_trim','rc'],1),
        ('checker not self',['drat_trim','stop'],'term'),('bad verdict',['drat_trim','s_lines'],['s NOT VERIFIED']),
        ('extra verdict',['drat_trim','s_lines'],['s VERIFIED','s VERIFIED']),('interrupted',['checker_interrupted'],True),
        ('abort',['aborted_by_sigterm'],True),('proof cap',['proof_cap_hit'],'zbuf-tail'),
        ('admission refused',['admission_denied'],'floor'),('checker path',['drat_trim_binary'],'lrat-check'),
        ('wrong solver limit',['solver'],r['solver'].replace('--time=600','--time=1800')),
        ('wrong seed',['solver_info','seed'],'--seed=2'),('check limit',['check_budget'],1201)]:
        setp(label,keys,val)
    for label,q in cases:
        assert mod.proof_errors(q,ex), ('accepted corruption',label)
    return [label for label,_ in cases]


def transaction_controls(c,ref,root,contract_sha,mod=C):
    """Synthetic PRIVATE metadata only, never a relabelled/consumed production calibration receipt."""
    controls = []
    ca = next(x for x in c['cases'] if x['b_index'] == 9)
    template = C.read(REAL_LANE/ref['record'])
    variants = ('valid','missing-pin','missing-commit','wrong-commit-sha','boolean-pin-index',
                'wrong-runner','old-guard-new-record','false-coverage-flag','wrong-denominator','wrong-formula')
    saved_lane = mod.LANE
    try:
        for name in variants:
            d = root/('tx-'+name+'-'+str(time.time_ns()))
            d.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
            mod.LANE = d
            it = {'new_record':'test-record.json','pin':'test-pin.json','commit':'test-commit.json','indices':[0,99]}
            pin = {'schema':'PA19-K1-CNF-PIN-v1','production_contract_sha256':contract_sha,'b_index':9,'indices':[0,99],
                   'list_sha256':ca['list']['sha256'],'complete_denominator':ca['list']['n'],
                   'skeleton_sha256':c['skeleton_sha256'],'encoder_sha256':c['source_sha256']['src/encode_skel_b.py'],
                   'cnf_sha256':ref['cnf_sha256'],'cnf_bytes':ref['expected']['cnf_bytes']}
            r = copy.deepcopy(template)
            for k in list(r):
                if k.startswith('calibration_') or k in ('purpose','contract_sha256','chunk_alarm_fired'):
                    r.pop(k)
            r.update(runner='run_m2_ms09_k1.py',enumerator='extend_b.py',production_contract_sha256=contract_sha,
                     list_sha256=ca['list']['sha256'],complete_denominator=ca['list']['n'],count_for_scientific_coverage=True)
            if name == 'boolean-pin-index': pin['indices'] = [False,99]
            if name == 'wrong-runner': r['runner'] = 'unapproved.py'
            if name == 'old-guard-new-record': r['stream_check_revision'] = 14
            if name == 'false-coverage-flag': r['count_for_scientific_coverage'] = False
            if name == 'wrong-denominator': r['complete_denominator'] += 1
            if name == 'wrong-formula': pin['cnf_sha256'] = r['cnf_sha256'] = '0'*64
            pinraw = (json.dumps(pin,indent=1)+'\n').encode()
            ph = hashlib.sha256(pinraw).hexdigest()
            r['pre_child_pin_sha256'] = ph
            rr = (json.dumps(r,indent=1)+'\n').encode()
            commit = {'schema':'PA19-K1-RECEIPT-v1','production_contract_sha256':contract_sha,
                      'b_index':9,'indices':[0,99],'pin_sha256':ph,'record_sha256':hashlib.sha256(rr).hexdigest()}
            if name == 'wrong-commit-sha': commit['record_sha256'] = '0'*64
            if name != 'missing-pin':
                with (d/it['pin']).open('xb') as f: f.write(pinraw)
            if name != 'missing-commit': dump_x(d/it['commit'],commit)
            with (d/it['new_record']).open('xb') as f: f.write(rr)
            q = mod.inspect_new(c,contract_sha,ca,it,False)
            if name in ('valid','wrong-formula'):
                assert q['state'] == 'QUALIFIED', (name,q)
            else:
                assert q['state'] != 'QUALIFIED', (name,q)
            if name == 'wrong-formula':
                for rel in (c['skeleton_path'],ca['list']['path']):
                    target = d/rel
                    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
                    os.symlink(REAL_LANE/rel,target)
                assert mod.inspect_new(c,contract_sha,ca,it,True)['state'] != 'QUALIFIED'
            controls.append(name)
    finally:
        mod.LANE = saved_lane
    return controls


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('contract')
    ap.add_argument('sha256')
    args = ap.parse_args()
    c = C.load(args.contract,args.sha256)
    root = REAL_LANE/'cycle2'/('m2k1-controls-'+str(time.time_ns()))
    root.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    ref = next(x for x in c['calibration_reservations'] if x['b_index'] == 9)
    r = C.read(REAL_LANE/ref['record'])
    ex = ref['expected']
    pc = proof_controls(E,r,ex)
    # Source-level mutants must fail a dedicated predicate control, not merely rely on frozen-file hashes.
    esource = Path(E.__file__).read_text()
    emutations = {
      'known_revision': ("    need(is_int(r.get('stream_check_revision')) and r['stream_check_revision'] in KNOWN_STAGED,'unsupported/missing staged revision')",''),
      'input_identity': ("        need(is_int(r.get(key)) and r[key] == expected[key],'identity differs: '+key)",'        pass'),
      'formula_SHA': ("    need(r.get('cnf_sha256') == expected.get('cnf_sha256'),'CNF SHA not exact expected formula')",''),
      'exact_verdict': ("    need(isinstance(dt,dict) and dt.get('s_lines') == ['s VERIFIED'] and dt.get('says_verified') is True,'checker verdict not exactly s VERIFIED')",''),
      'delivered_bytes': ("    need(isinstance(replay,dict) and is_int(replay.get('bytes')) and replay['bytes'] == n and replay.get('sha256') == ph,'delivered proof bytes/SHA differ')",'')}
    kills = []
    for name,(a,b) in emutations.items():
        assert esource.count(a) == 1
        source = esource.replace(a,b,1)
        mod = types.ModuleType('evidence_mutant_'+name)
        exec(compile(source,'private-'+name,'exec'),mod.__dict__)
        failure = None
        try: proof_controls(mod,r,ex)
        except Exception as exc: failure = repr(exc)[:500]
        assert failure is not None, ('survived predicate mutant',name)
        kills.append({'protection':name,'killed':True,'failure':failure,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest()})
    # Immutable record-byte binding, including semantically identical JSON re-serialization.
    rp = root/'record.json'
    original = (REAL_LANE/ref['record']).read_bytes()
    with rp.open('xb') as f: f.write(original)
    assert E.inspect(rp,ex,ref['record_sha256'])['state'] == 'QUALIFIED'
    os.rename(rp,root/'retained-original-record.json')
    with rp.open('xb') as f: f.write(original+b'\n')
    assert E.inspect(rp,ex,ref['record_sha256'])['state'] != 'QUALIFIED'
    inv_controls = ['record SHA pins exact bytes, not merely parsed flags']
    # Mutated contract fields require no scientific-file changes.
    for label,change in [
        ('missing required source',lambda q:q['source_sha256'].pop('src/run_m2_ms09_k1.py')),
        ('wrong phase authority',lambda q:q.__setitem__('phase_sha256','0'*64)),
        ('wrong case identity',lambda q:q['cases'][4].__setitem__('b_index',False)),
        ('denominator shrink',lambda q:q['cases'][4]['list'].__setitem__('n',0)),
        ('interval omission',lambda q:q['cases'][4]['intervals'].pop()),
        ('interval duplication',lambda q:q['cases'][4]['intervals'].append(copy.deepcopy(q['cases'][4]['intervals'][0]))),
        ('pending order change',lambda q:q['pending_order'].reverse()),
        ('missing calibration reservation',lambda q:q['reserved_ids'].pop())]:
        q = copy.deepcopy(c)
        change(q)
        rejected = False
        try: C.verify_sources(q)
        except (AssertionError,KeyError,ValueError,OSError,StopIteration): rejected = True
        assert rejected,label
        inv_controls.append(label)
    # Only the exact parent B3 structural input can ever consume an empty cover.
    empty = {'b_index':4,'list':{'n':0,'sha256':C.B3.EXPECTED['empty_list_receipt']['sha256']}}
    assert C.structural_acceptance(c,empty)['accepted'] is False
    empty['b_index'] = 3
    empty['list']['n'] = False
    assert C.structural_acceptance(c,empty)['accepted'] is False
    empty['list']['n'] = 0
    empty['list']['sha256'] = '0'*64
    assert C.structural_acceptance(c,empty)['accepted'] is False
    inv_controls += ['no generic empty-cover acceptance','boolean empty denominator rejected','wrong empty-list SHA rejected']
    # Independent SAT discovery catches unrecognized/aborted/calibration candidates and malformed JSON.
    shadow = root/'sat-shadow'
    cases = [shadow/'cycle2'/'m2part_drat'/'ms09_b00004'/'unrecognized-extra.json',
             shadow/'cycle2'/'aborted'/'one.json',shadow/'cycle2'/'m2k1-chunks'/'one'/'SAT-one.json']
    for p in cases: dump_x(p,{'status':'SAT','fifo_dir':'scratch/fifo/ms09_b00004'})
    bad = shadow/'cycle2'/'m2part_drat'/'ms09_b00004'/'bad.json'
    with bad.open('x') as f: f.write('{bad')
    saved = C.LANE
    try:
        C.LANE = shadow
        sats,issues = C.sat_scan()
        assert len(sats) == 3 and len(issues) == 1
    finally:
        C.LANE = saved
    inv_controls += ['unrecognized/aborted/chunk SAT candidates veto','malformed scientific JSON fails closed']
    # Exact-input overlay cannot be self-issued in the worker lane.
    proposal = {'schema':'PA19-MS09-CALIBRATION-REUSE-v1','production_contract_sha256':args.sha256,
      'accepted':[{'id':ref['id'],'record_sha256':ref['record_sha256'],'cnf_sha256':ref['cnf_sha256'],
        'list_sha256':ref['list_sha256'],'indices':ref['indices'],'scope':'EXACT_INPUT_ONLY'}]}
    op = root/'self-issued-parent.json'
    dump_x(op,proposal)
    denied = False
    try: C.parent_reuse(c,args.sha256,op,E.digest(op))
    except AssertionError: denied = True
    assert denied and C.parent_reuse(c,args.sha256) == {}
    inv_controls.append('worker cannot self-authorize calibration reuse')
    # No-replace publication must preserve an existing file and its bytes.
    dest = root/'atomic.json'
    h = C.publish_json(dest,{'first':True},root/'staging')
    denied = False
    try: C.publish_json(dest,{'second':True},root/'staging')
    except FileExistsError: denied = True
    assert denied and E.digest(dest) == h
    inv_controls.append('atomic publication collision never overwrites')
    snap = C.inventory(c,args.sha256)
    assert not snap['final_ms09_acceptance_ready'] and snap['closed_cases_for_final'] == 0
    assert set(snap['parent_calibration_reservations_pending']) == set(c['reserved_ids'])
    b70 = next(x for x in snap['rows'] if x['b_index'] == 70)
    assert b70['state'] == 'OPEN' and b70['intervals'][0]['state'] == 'RESERVED_PARENT_DISPOSITION'
    inv_controls.append('all seven calibration proofs remain pending without parent disposition')
    tx_controls = transaction_controls(c,ref,root,args.sha256)
    csource = Path(C.__file__).read_text()
    cmutations = {
      'required_sources': ("    assert set(c['source_sha256']) == set(SOURCE_FILES), 'required frozen source set differs'",'    pass'),
      'structural_exact_case': ("ca['b_index'] == 3 and ",''),
      'SAT_discovery': ("        if isinstance(r,dict) and r.get('status') == 'SAT':",'        if False:'),
      'parent_ownership': ("    assert p.is_relative_to(REVIEW.resolve()), 'reuse disposition must be in read-only parent review ownership'",'    pass'),
      'deterministic_full_order': ("    assert c['pending_order'] == order, 'compute order is not the exact deterministic full unresolved partition'",'    pass')}
    policy_kills = []
    for name,(a,b) in cmutations.items():
        assert csource.count(a) == 1,name
        source = csource.replace(a,b,1)
        mod = types.ModuleType('policy_mutant_'+name)
        mod.__file__ = C.__file__
        exec(compile(source,'private-policy-'+name,'exec'),mod.__dict__)
        failure = None
        try:
            if name in ('required_sources','deterministic_full_order'):
                q = copy.deepcopy(c)
                if name == 'required_sources': q['source_sha256'].pop('src/run_m2_ms09_k1.py')
                else: q['pending_order'].reverse()
                rejected = False
                try: mod.verify_sources(q)
                except (AssertionError,KeyError,ValueError,OSError,StopIteration): rejected = True
                assert rejected
            elif name == 'structural_exact_case':
                q = {'b_index':4,'list':{'n':0,'sha256':C.B3.EXPECTED['empty_list_receipt']['sha256']}}
                assert mod.structural_acceptance(c,q)['accepted'] is False
            elif name == 'SAT_discovery':
                mod.LANE = shadow
                s,badrows = mod.sat_scan()
                assert len(s) == 3 and len(badrows) == 1
            else:
                rejected = False
                try: mod.parent_reuse(c,args.sha256,op,E.digest(op))
                except AssertionError: rejected = True
                assert rejected
        except Exception as exc:
            failure = repr(exc)[:500]
        assert failure is not None, ('survived policy mutant',name)
        policy_kills.append({'protection':name,'killed':True,'failure':failure,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest()})
    record = {'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),'contract_sha256':args.sha256,
       'evidence_source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(esource.encode()).hexdigest(),'inventory_source_sha256':E.digest(C.__file__),
       'proof_predicate_controls':pc,'proof_predicate_control_count':len(pc),'single_protection_mutants':kills,
       'policy_single_protection_mutants':policy_kills,
       'private_transaction_controls':tx_controls,'private_transaction_control_count':len(tx_controls),
       'inventory_policy_controls':inv_controls,'inventory_policy_control_count':len(inv_controls),
       'scientific_solvers_or_checkers_started':0,'original_evidence_unchanged':True,
       'scope':'metadata/identity/coverage-policy controls only; no DRAT/native mutation claim; no global PA19 acceptance'}
    dest = root/'receipt.json'
    dump_x(dest,record)
    print(dest)
    print(json.dumps({'predicate_controls':len(pc),'predicate_mutants_killed':len(kills),'policy_mutants_killed':len(policy_kills),'inventory_policy_controls':len(inv_controls),'native_starts':0}))
